scales.name: Blues Hexatonic
scales.source: Levine, Mark (1995). The Jazz Theory Book. Petaluma, CA: Sher Music Co., ch. 'Blues Scales'.
scales.description: Minor pentatonic plus the flat-five 'blue note' passing tone.

scales.name: Minor Pentatonic
scales.source: Levine, Mark (1995). The Jazz Theory Book. Petaluma, CA: Sher Music Co., ch. 'Blues Scales'.
scales.description: Pitch-identical to the Chinese Yu mode and Korean kyemyonjo in the East Asia file - the anhemitonic minor pentatonic is a cross-culturally universal collection, not a copy-paste error; each entry is independently sourced to its own tradition.

scales.name: Major Pentatonic
scales.source: Levine, Mark (1995). The Jazz Theory Book. Petaluma, CA: Sher Music Co., ch. 'Blues Scales'.
scales.description: Pitch-identical to the Chinese Gong mode in the East Asia file, for the same reason noted on Minor Pentatonic: the anhemitonic major pentatonic recurs independently across unrelated traditions.
